author: Practical Engineering
description:
I love transmission towers!
Want to restore the planet’s ecosystems and see your impact in monthly videos? The first 100 people to join Planet Wild with my code PRACTICAL11 will get the first month paid for by me: https://planetwild.com/r/practicalengineering/join/11
If you want to get to know them better first, check out their mission rewilding power lines: https://planetwild.com/r/practicalengineering/m15/11

So much of our modern life is hidden behind shiny enclosures or abstracted away from us without a single hint on the outside about what’s happening on the inside. Electrical transmission lines are the opposite.

📖My new book, Disasters By Design: How Engineering Failures Shaped the Modern World is coming March 2, 2027 and available for preorder now.
US: https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/786143/disasters-by-design-by-grady-hillhouse/
UK: https://www.penguin.co.uk/books/476190/disasters-by-design-by-hillhouse-grady/9780241798508
More About the Book: https://practical.engin
